synopsis: The glossary identifies VEOS as dSPACE’s PC-based virtual ECU simulation tool, alongside SCALEXIO for real-time HIL; Chapter 11 describes the combined SCALEXIO, VEOS and AURELION offering as a strong route from software-in-the-loop to hardware-in-the-loop testing with virtual sensors [f16034, f8639, f8640]. Vendor findings explicitly support a chain combining ASM, AURELION, VEOS and ModelDesk, and integration of AURELION and SIMPHERA with the broader dSPACE HIL ecosystem [f8704, f8448]. Sensor injection remains sensor- and ECU-specific, with camera video, radar targets, Ethernet streams and raw stimulation posing materially different engineering problems; the listed evidence is on-road only, leaving off-road applicability unestablished by that evidence [f8641, f9220]. J1939 emulation is reported possible per ISO/TS 21815-2 [f9221]. These commercial tools appear in the highest-cost example validation chain, but neither a public price nor a full-system price was found, limiting budget certainty [f9219, f9303, f16166, f9222, f8642].

relations.note: Both place the dSPACE combination among highest-cost commercial validation chain examples.
Glossary distinguishes VEOS virtual ECU simulation from SCALEXIO real-time HIL within the listed offering.
Virtual-sensor ECU and HIL execution supports the claimed SIL-to-HIL route.
Sensor injection requires modality- and ECU-specific engineering despite execution support.
Listed evidence for the claimed testing route is limited to on-road applications.
Explicit support for the named tool chain reinforces broader ecosystem integration.
Interface listing adds OSI compatibility and SIL/HIL to the ecosystem integration description.
Reported HIL execution supports inclusion among data replay and HIL offerings.
J1939 emulation adds a specific protocol capability to the interface picture.
Pricing gaps cover both public prices and a full-system price.
Commercial status supports classification as a commercial validation platform example.
Highest-cost categorization lacks a reported full-system price.
